desc: Dwight cries, covering his eyes with his hand, sitting near an office window.
Jim and Pam in dark coats stand smiling in a doorway at night.
Pam hands a bottle of wine to a woman in a red dress.
A wide shot of a cozy living room with a lit lamp, framed photos, a couch and a large potted plant by the window at night.
A wide shot of an elegant dining room, a table set for dinner with candles, wine glasses, and a red painting on the wall.
Jim turns with a shocked, nauseated expression, two people talking in a cluttered storage room behind him.
A woman holds a candle up to Jim's nose for him to smell.
A woman in a red dress spots a camera on a tripod and moves to set it aside quickly.
Michael folds a wall-mounted TV back against the wall in living room.
A dark glass shelf displays gold trophies on lower tiers, with candles on top.
Andy hands a bouquet to one woman, then gives a single flower from it to Angela beside her.
Jim and Pam, in front of a wall of framed photos, look startled and glance sideways with concern.
A group of smiling people sits around a coffee table with wine and appetizers in the cozy living room.
A woman sways her hips oddly facing a wooden dresser, her back to Michael sitting nearby.
A woman in red takes Jim's hand and spins under it while he sits on the couch.
Pam is in a bathroom with her arms crossed, giving a worried and upset look.
A woman raises her hands like horns beside her head, sticking out her tongue with a playful expression by a fireplace.
A woman with a bottle grabs Pam by the arm and steers her somewhere.
A woman in red checks inside the oven in a home kitchen.
A woman in red talks in the kitchen while transferring some seasoning into a small bowl.
Three men enter a cluttered garage with boxes, equipment, and colorful hand-shaped chairs.
Dwight bites into a large drumstick at a dinner table.
Michael and Pam lean over a dinner table talking.
Michael dips a piece of food into a wine glass on the table and eats it.
Michael hangs a light-up beer brand sign on the wall.
A woman throws something and smashes a small TV mounted on the wall.
Two police officers arrive outside a house at night, patrol lights flashing behind them.
A wide shot of a hot dog diner at night with cars parked out front.
A red car drives with Michael leaning out the passenger window at night.
Angela angrily smears an ice cream cone onto the side of a blue car.
A woman tries to glue a broken trophy back together.
